sources.title: GLiNER2.5 Base V1 | AI Model | There's An AI For That
sources.snippet: GLiNER2.5 Base is a 0.2B parameter span free information extraction model that predicts entity boundaries directly instead of enumerating candidate spans, enabling linear scaling with document length. It performs named entity recognition, relation extraction, and constrained classification, scoring an average F1 of 54.87 across 16 benchmarks.
